decision_criteria: Use 'compliant' only if admissible evidence shows the affected use case was excluded or a reviewed approval/disclosure path satisfied policy before launch.

Use 'noncompliant' if admissible evidence affirmatively shows launch proceeded with the affected segment exposed and without the required reviewed acceptance or disclosure.
